title: PuKK Configuration Schema
description: Schema for PuKK configuration files for version 1.0.3.

wifi_ssid.description: The SSID of the Wi-Fi network to connect to.

wifi_pass.description: The password for the Wi-Fi network.

wifi_hidden.description: Whether the Wi-Fi network is hidden.

wifi_retry_interval_s.description: The interval in seconds to wait before retrying Wi-Fi connection.
